method: CUA rendered screenshots and read-only live DOM computed styles; actual card navigation and search UI
scope: Four public sites, homepage and one store sample at 1440x1000 and 375x844, plus representative directory/category/offer/event/article/information pages
measurementNotes: CSS pixels, not image-pixel estimates. Initial mixed-width exploratory measurements were excluded from the normalized table.
Store gap is second card top minus first card bottom, excluding intervening ad slots. A CSS gap of normal can coexist with 20px card margins.
The desktop store samples are Taco Bueno except Dealmerica, which uses Chewy. They are equivalent page purposes, not identical content.
375px browser viewport has a 360px document area with a 15px scrollbar in this environment. Phone gutters use the document area.
Measurements are reference examples, not hard universal values or evidence of full-site acceptance. Refresh live references before a later release review.
Screenshots were visually inspected in CUA; this file archives measurements and observations, not screenshot files.

observedIssuesNotToPromote: Phone title truncation and 11-12px metadata are observed reference treatments, not replacements for current full-title and 14px policies.
Ad slots and Watch an ad to get the promo code are commercial modules, outside the current no-ad generation scope.
Category summary quantities match merchant-count meaning; labels such as deals cannot be copied without count-kind verification.
Meal-delivery Factor detail describes a business-process optimization tool: observed entity/content mismatch, not a safe reusable content example.
The references share route patterns, IDs and many records. Shared implementation/data is an inference; four sites are not four independent industry samples.
